Primary Care Progress Note

Polysomnography Report
Date: 11/27/2025
Patient: Ja Hand, 68 y/o F

Attended PSG 11/27/2025. Sleep latency 15 min, TST 360 min, SE 85%. REM 18%, N3 20%. AHI 19.6/h. CA+MA 6% of total AHI. ODI 15/h. SpO2 nadir 88%. Periodic limb movements index 5/h. No significant arrhythmias noted. CPAP titration recommended based on findings.

Summary: Moderate OSA with mixed apneas present. Further clinical correlation advised.
